An '''HK-47 jetpack''' was a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] produced by reconfiguring [[HK-47]]'s body into jetpack form.

==Description==
The HK-47 personal jetpack consisted of a shell colored in HK-47's preferred shade of rusty red, with a pair or rocket thrusters flanking a core shaped somewhat like HK-47's head. A [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] displaying HK-47's original droid form was placed in the center of the jetpack's body, above a grill similar to the droid's [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and red lights resembling his [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].

The jetpack was worn on the back of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] form and used to propel the being through the air.

==History==
At some point during or prior to [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], HK-47's body was reconfigured into a jetpack. This was done over his strenuous objections. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the jetpack came into the possession of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].
